scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=shared && concurrently -k -n srv,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=web && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=shared && tsc --noEmit -p shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
